summary: Collection full-catalog fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter_collection_full_catalog.py. GET /api/user/{guest_id}/collection returns total=493 for a brand-new user in both lang=it and lang=en, with exactly 12 category groups. Per-group totals: scienza=53 and every other category (animali, storia, economia, natura, geografia, cultura, tecnologia, spazio, arte, psicologia, corpo-umano, lezioni) = 40, summing to 53 + 11×40 = 493 — matching the user's expectation. For a fresh guest: unlocked=0, every group has stories=[] and locked_ids length == total. After POST /api/user/complete on both a 'story' (curiosità) and a 'lesson', unlocked rises to 2, each completed id disappears from locked_ids and appears in the correct group's stories[] with full StoryPreview payload. Frontend: /collection screen loads at mobile 390×844 for a guest, summary ring shows '0 /493', progress label 'STORIES COMPLETED' is visible, collection-empty tagline shows, all 12 category rows render with the exact per-group counts observed in the API (0/40 ×11 and 0/53 for scienza), 264+ LockedCard tiles render across the horizontal FlatLists, no red screen, no crashes. Only pre-existing non-blocking warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents prop, Reanimated easing on web) remain from prior iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' – pre-existing, non-blocking.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning on first render – pre-existing, non-blocking.
'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' – pre-existing, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1386-1415 user_collection now iterates ALL stories (chapters projected out) and groups by category_id, then enumerates every category — so Premium early-access novità and lessons are included as locked_ids even for free users. This matches the fix description.

server.py:1395 uses .find({}, {'_id': 0, 'chapters': 0}).sort('created_at', 1).to_list(5000) — the 5000 ceiling comfortably covers 493 stories; if the catalog grows past 5000 the limit should be revisited.

server.py:1402-1404 'if not items: continue' means a category with zero stories is dropped from the response — currently all 12 configured categories have stories (scienza 53, lezioni 40, etc.), so this is fine and prevents empty 0/0 cards.
collection.tsx:93-96 renders data.unlocked and data.total raw — correctly displays '0 /493' for guests; no NaN or '0 of 254' remaining.
collection.tsx:160 per-group count label uses `${g.unlocked}/${g.total}` — matches API grouping.
Frontend contract (CollectionGroup in /app/frontend/src/api.ts) must include 'total', 'unlocked', 'stories', 'locked_ids' — confirmed via UI (locked tiles render from locked_ids).
seed_data_creation: Each test uses a fresh TEST_coll_<uuid> guest id; no persistent seed data left behind beyond the single user_state doc (ephemeral).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collection endpoint: GET /api/user/{user_id}/collection?lang=it|en returns {total, unlocked, categories:[{id,name,color,total,unlocked,stories[],locked_ids[]}]}. For a new user total MUST be 493 and categories length 12 (scienza=53, others=40). Completion is driven by POST /api/user/complete {user_id, story_id, minutes, seconds}. The frontend screen /collection reads from api.collection(userId) via useQuery; renders testIDs: collection-screen, collection-summary, collection-count ('N'), collection-empty, collection-group-{catId}, collection-group-count-{catId} ('N/total'), collection-card-{storyId}, collection-locked-{storyId}. If the user later complains the number is wrong, verify db.stories count == 493 with `db.stories.countDocuments()` and that each category_id maps to a configured category in list_categories().
rca_of_issue: Before the fix, user_collection iterated only completed_story_ids (or a subset of categories), so a fresh user saw 0/254 instead of 0/493 — the 254 figure was coming from a subset (likely curiosità categories excluding lezioni and Premium early-access novità). The fix widens the aggregation to the full db.stories collection grouped by category_id and treats every uncompleted story as a locked card. Verified: /api/user/<fresh>/collection → total=493, 12 groups (scienza 53 + 11×40), unlocked=0, locked_ids sums to 493.
